battle.name: 甑山、溳口之戰
battle.brief: 開皇二年（582）十一月，隋文帝乘陳宣帝新喪，遣晉王楊廣掛名行軍元帥，率諸王諸軍號稱五十一萬，自六合沿淮河北進；陳廷遣都督袁君正等拒守溳口一線，隋軍進逼甑山，陳軍大敗，死者以萬計。卡面這件秦連弩，正是此役中進攻方用來壓制渡口守軍、守城方用來封鎖淮岸的器械。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這是開皇二年（582）隋朝第一次大舉南征陳朝時的一場前哨戰，交戰地帶在江淮之間的溳口、甑山一線。隋方是北周禪代後建立的隋朝，國主為隋文帝楊堅；開皇二年十一月，隋文帝以剛封為晉王的楊廣掛名行軍元帥，率秦王楊俊、齊王楊秀等諸王各領一軍，分道南出，兵馬總數見於《隋書·高祖紀》與《資治通鑑》者為五十一萬，其中夾雜大量隨軍運糧的民夫，實際戰鬥兵員應遠少於此。隋軍的指揮系統以元帥、行軍總管、州刺史三層為骨架，諸王幕府各置長史、記室參贊軍務，糧道則自江北大營沿泗水、淮水逐段接續，舟船由新造與徵發湊成。陳方是建都建康的陳朝，國主陳叔寶；陳宣帝於同年新崩，陳後主以荒唐著稱，朝中以張貴妃一派與外州宿將交相掣肘。陳廷在淮南倚濠州、泗州、楚州一線的城池與淮水天塹拒守，遣都督袁君正等率兵赴溳口前沿，在甑山列陣迎敵，並以木柵、水壘與城頭弩陣封鎖渡口。第三方是北方草原的突厥：同一時期隋朝正在北面用兵，江淮的戰事因此被迫在有限的時間與有限的糧秣之內打成，雙方都沒有把主力一次投入。
countriesEn: This was a forward engagement fought in the second year of Kaihuang (582), during the first great southern campaign the Sui dynasty launched against the Chen, and it took place on the line of Bingkou and Zengshan between the Yangtze and the Huai. On the Sui side stood the dynasty created on the abdication of the Northern Zhou, ruled by Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian. In the eleventh month of Kaihuang 2 the emperor named Yang Guang, just created Prince of Jin, as commander-in-chief in name, and sent out the princes Yang Jun of Qin, Yang Xiu of Qi and the other princes, each commanding a separate army along a separate road. The total of five hundred and ten thousand men given for this host in the Gaoji ji of the Suishu and in the Zizhi tongjian plainly includes a great many military servants and porters carrying grain; the real fighting strength was far smaller, and historians have long read the figure as a declaration of intent rather than a count of men on the rolls. Sui command ran on three levels, the commander-in-chief, the army superintendent and the provincial governor, while each prince had a staff of chancellors and record-keepers to transact the business of the army. The supply line was carried in stages from the great camp north of the Yangtze down the Si and the Huai, and the river craft came partly from new construction and partly from requisition. On the Chen side was the dynasty with its capital at Jiankang, ruled by Chen Shubao, the Houzhu. Emperor Xuan of Chen had died earlier in that same year, the new court was torn between the palace faction of the consort Zhang and the veteran generals of the outer provinces, and Chen relied on the fortified line of Haozhou, Sizhou and Chuzhou together with the natural barrier of the Huai. It sent the commandery superintendent Yuan Junzheng and others forward to the Bingkou front, where they took up a position at Zengshan, closed the crossing with wooden fences, water barriers and ranks of crossbowmen on the walls. A third party stood to the north in the steppe, the Turks: the Sui was fighting there at the same moment, so the fighting in the Yangtze and Huai region had to be compressed into a limited stretch of time and a limited stock of grain, and neither side could put its main strength into the field all at once.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的是三層人物。最高的一層是隋文帝楊堅：他在北周任丞相時已經着手清除宗室諸王，奪得帝位之後又在開皇初年下詔，禁止江南民間私藏兵器、限制車牛，藉口是防範亂萌，實則是把南方的兵源與財力先行卡住。開皇二年十一月，陳宣帝新崩，隋廷派使南下弔祭的同時下詔出兵，晉王楊廣在出征前受封為晉王並授行軍元帥，出兵的名目寫的是陳國內有逆賊、隋軍奉辭討伐；主帥之位給了當年僅十三歲的楊廣，軍中實際運籌的是諸王幕府的長史與諸將，這是隋朝第一次以諸王分道、各自統兵的大規模用兵。陳方的主事者是陳後主陳叔寶與陳廷的老將。陳後主把淮南防務倚託在外州宿將蕭摩訶等人身上，自己在建康的宮禁中與張貴妃一同歌舞，邊報屢至而處置遲緩；陳宣帝之死又使淮南軍心浮動。直接在前線指揮的是陳都督袁君正，其名見於《資治通鑑》開皇二年十一月條；史籍對此役陳方主將的記載有出入，但可確定陳廷派出的拒守部隊是被隋軍在正面交鋒中擊散的。江南士人賀若弼早年向隋廷陳述南朝形勢、主張預作防備，其奏議見於《隋書》本傳，說明伐陳並非一時興起，而是隋朝內部長期的籌劃。
peopleEn: Three layers of men determined the course of this war. The highest was Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian. Already as chancellor under the Northern Zhou he had begun to clear the imperial princes off the board, and once he had taken the throne he issued an order in the early Kaihuang years forbidding the people south of the Yangtze to keep weapons in private hands and restricting carts and oxen, on the pretext of forestalling the seeds of disorder and in truth to throttle the southern sources of men and money. In the eleventh month of Kaihuang 2, with the death of Emperor Xuan of Chen still fresh, the Sui court sent an envoy south to offer condolences and issued the order to march in the same breath; Yang Guang was created Prince of Jin and appointed commander-in-chief just before the campaign, and the ostensible ground of the expedition was that a rebellion had broken out inside the Chen and the Sui army was answering the call of the loyal. The command was given to a Yang Guang who was only thirteen years old, and the real working of the army fell to the chancellors and generals of the several princely staffs: this was the first time the Sui fought a large war with the princes leading separate armies by separate roads. On the Chen side the men in charge were the Houzhu, Chen Shubao, and the old generals of the Chen court. The Houzhu leaned on the veteran commanders of the outer provinces, such as Xiao Moha of Xuzhou, to guard the Huai, while he himself sang and danced inside the palace at Jiankang with the consort Zhang, and reports from the front piled up unhandled; the death of Emperor Xuan added to the unrest of the troops in the Huai region. The man actually directing the front was the Chen commandery superintendent Yuan Junzheng, whose name appears in the eleventh-month entry for Kaihuang 2 in the Zizhi tongjian; the records disagree over the Chen commander of this particular action, but it is certain that the detachment Chen sent to hold the line was scattered in open battle by the Sui. The southern scholar He Ruobi had earlier laid before the Sui court a picture of the southern state and urged it to prepare in advance, and his memorial is preserved in his biography in the Suishu; the war against Chen was therefore not a sudden mood but a long plan formed inside the Sui.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩是公元前二百年上下的秦弩工藝，弩臂以木為之、機關用銅，張弦之後以踏蹶或腰力上弦，一扣一發，關鍵在於把弓弦的拉力存起來，不必逐次張滿。從戰國到秦漢，連弩多為單兵手持，弩的常規有效射程在一百五十步至二百步之間。到了這場戰爭的年代，這種機構已經過多次改良：曹魏馬鈞改進弩機，使一具弩可以接連發射；劉宋劉義隆更製成能一次連發數十矢的諸葛弩；南北朝以降，各軍都把蹶張弩與連弩列為常備，隋唐的軍器簿籍裏仍見其名。因此本役的箭雨來源有二：一是陳方把連弩排成一列架在城頭與土壘之後，覆蓋城下的進攻正面，壓住隋軍的披甲步卒；二是隋軍把弩陣布在渡口與營壘後方，用密集的齊射壓制陳軍的出擊與反衝。與弩並用的是撞車、巢車、雲梯、飛樓一類攻城器械，以及沿泗水、淮水調集的舟船。開皇四年之後，隋廷整治山陽瀆一線的運河，糧秣可由江北大營直運江邊，江淮作戰的補給問題由此鬆動。隋軍的護身以鐵葉甲與札甲為主，步卒用大盾與環首刀，陳軍則以木柵、水壘與鐵鏃弩箭守城，並在城頭擺拒馬、鹿角以障礙登城者。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card belongs to the Qin craft of about 200 BC: a wooden stock carrying a bronze lock, cocked by stepping on the stirrup or by the strength of the loins, one bolt to a pull, the whole point being that the tension of the string is stored rather than renewed by drawing the bow each time. From the Warring States through the Han the repeating crossbow was a single-handed weapon, with a normal effective range of about one hundred and fifty to two hundred paces. By the time of this battle the mechanism had been improved many times: Cao Wei's Ma Jun reworked the lock so that one bow could fire a sequence of shots, and Liu Song's Emperor Wen, Liu Yilong, had a weapon made that could discharge several tens of bolts in a single burst, the Zhuge repeating crossbow; from the Southern and Northern dynasties onward the pedal crossbow and the repeating crossbow were standard issue, and both are still listed among the armaments of the Sui and Tang. The volume of arrows in this campaign therefore came from two sources: the Chen side ranged repeating crossbows in line on the walls and behind the earthworks so that their fire covered the frontal approach of the assault and pinned the armoured Sui foot; the Sui in turn deployed ranks of crossbowmen behind the crossing and their own entrenchments, using massed volleys to check the Chen counter-charge. Working with them were rams, siege towers, scaling ladders and flying towers for the assault, and river craft mustered along the Si and the Huai. After Kaihuang 4 the Sui court worked on the Shan Yang channel so that grain could be run straight down from the camps north of the Yangtze to the river bank, which loosened the supply problem of fighting in the middle Yangtze and Huai. The Sui were covered by iron plate and lamellar armour, their foot carried large shields and ring-pommel sabres, while the Chen defended with wooden fences, water barriers and iron-tipped bolts, and lined their walls with cheval-de-frise and caltrops to hinder those who tried to mount the walls.
tactics: 隋軍的部署是典型的分道疾進：諸王各領一軍，自六合、合肥一帶的集結地同時出發，前鋒不待全軍集齊便沿淮河北岸向西推進，企圖以突進的姿態把陳軍從城池裏引到曠野上決戰。陳軍不願放棄城垣的優勢，於是選擇甑山一帶列陣迎敵，以木柵與土壘在陣前設障，弩手列於壘後，步卒居中，騎兵在兩翼窺伺隋軍的側背。接戰之後，隋軍先以弩陣齊射覆蓋陳軍陣前，再以步卒持盾緩進，試圖壓住壘後的連弩手；陳軍則倚靠壘陣與城垣的相互支援，用城頭和陣後的連弩在窄面上反覆覆蓋，把隋軍的攻勢壓在城外。隋軍畢竟沒有傾盡兵力攻陳的州城：一來是冬季淮河上下游的糧道太長，運糧的船車一程拖一程；二來是北面與突厥的戰事同時在進行，隋廷不敢在這一線久留；三來是陳軍雖敗而淮南城防未破，深入便要承受被斷糧的風險。於是隋軍在奪得溳口渡口、擊破甑山陣之後，沒有繼續向江淮縱深追擊，而是收兵整隊，把這一場戰果變成下一次進攻的跳板。
tacticsEn: The Sui deployment was a textbook of advance by separate roads. Each prince led his own army, the armies set out together from the assembly grounds around Liuhe and Hefei, and the leading troops pushed west along the north bank of the Huai without waiting for the whole force to concentrate, in the hope of dragging the Chen out of its cities and onto open ground where they would be fought. The Chen were unwilling to give up the advantage of their walls, and chose instead to take up a position at Zengshan, fencing the front of the line with wooden stockades and earthworks, placing the crossbowmen behind the works, the foot in the centre and the cavalry on both wings to watch for a turn of the Sui flank. Once contact was made the Sui opened with volleys from the crossbow line covering the front of the Chen position, then advanced slowly with shielded foot in the hope of suppressing the repeating crossbowmen behind the works; the Chen, leaning on the mutual support of the earthworks and the city walls, answered with their own repeating crossbows on the walls and behind the line, covering the narrow approaches again and again and holding the Sui assault outside the walls. In the end the Sui did not commit their strength against the Chen prefectures: the winter grain road along the Huai was too long, the boats and carts carrying it lagged from stage to stage; the war against the Turks in the north was being fought at the same time and the court would not stay long on this front; and although the Chen had been beaten, the defences of the Huai cities were not broken, so a deep advance would have risked having the supply line cut. The Sui therefore, having taken the crossing at Bingkou and shattered the line at Zengshan, did not press on into the depth of the Yangtze and Huai country but drew off and reformed, turning this one success into the stepping stone for the next attack.
data: 能確定的數字不多，先列見於史籍者。這場戰爭爆發於開皇二年（582）十一月，隋軍出兵的總數，《隋書·高祖紀》與《資治通鑑》都記作諸王率軍五十一萬，其中夾雜大量運糧民夫，實際戰鬥兵員應遠少於此，歷來史家多視此為宣示性的編制數而非點驗數。《資治通鑑》記此役陳軍大敗、死者萬餘人，這是關於陳方損失唯一的具體數字。距離方面，隋軍自六合一帶的集結地到溳口一線約四百至五百里；甑山在溳口以南、以西不遠的淮北丘陵，距淮水數里至數十不等。弩的常規有效射程約一百五十步至二百步，蹶張弩因臂力足、弓弦強還可射得更遠，具體數字各家記載不一。時間上，自十一月出兵到翌年春收兵，前後約半年，消耗的多是糧秣與船隻而非決戰。往後看，這一役只是隋滅陳的前哨：開皇八年（588）隋才全面出兵，造戰船萬餘艘；開皇九年（589）正月隋軍入建康，陳亡。若從隋文帝受禪的581年算起，到589年滅陳為八年；若只由582年甑山、溳口這一役算到589年正月的建康之戰，則是七年。
dataEn: Few figures can be established, and those that can are best given first. The war broke out in the eleventh month of Kaihuang 2 (582). The total of the Sui host is given in both the Gaoji ji of the Suishu and the Zizhi tongjian as five hundred and ten thousand men under the several princes; that figure is mixed with a large number of porters carrying grain, and the real strength in the line was much smaller, for which reason historians have generally taken it as a number announcing the scale of the effort rather than a count of those actually present. The Zizhi tongjian records that the Chen army was utterly defeated and that more than ten thousand of them were killed, and this is the only specific figure we have for the Chen losses. As to distance, the march from the assembly ground around Liuhe to the line of Bingkou was something like four to five hundred li, and Zengshan lay in the hills north of the Huai not far to the south and west of Bingkou, at a few li or a few tens of li from the river itself. The ordinary effective range of a crossbow was about one hundred and fifty to two hundred paces, and the pedal crossbow, with a stronger arm and stouter string, could shoot farther; the exact figures differ from source to source. In time, from the departure in the eleventh month to the withdrawal in the spring of the following year was about half a year, and what was consumed was grain, boats and time rather than a single decisive battle. Looking further ahead, this action was only the advance guard of the Sui war that ended the Chen: the Sui only came out in full force in Kaihuang 8 (588), building more than ten thousand war vessels, and in the first month of Kaihuang 9 (589) the Sui army entered Jiankang and the Chen perished. Counting from the year the Sui founder received the abdication in 581 to the fall of the Chen in 589 gives eight years; counting only from the action at Zengshan and Bingkou in 582 to the fall of Jiankang in the first month of 589 gives seven.
cause: 打起來的根由是二十多年不變的南北對峙。陳朝自557年建國便以長江天險自守，靠合肥、歷陽一線的城塞與淮南的水軍撐住與北方王朝的均勢；隋朝581年受禪之後，楊堅要的是一個能直接調兵、直接徵稅的統一帝國，南朝的存在對他既是障礙，也是可以整合進新王朝的資源。開皇二年之前，隋廷已做了三件實事：禁止江南民間私藏兵器、限制車牛，藉口是防範亂萌；遣使南下到淮南、江南各州探明虛實、收買人心，其中南士賀若弼關於江南形勢的奏議最有名；再就是連年整軍，開皇四年起整治山陽瀆一線的運河，使淮南的糧秣可以順流直下，開皇七八年之間更在長江中下游大造戰船，籌備舟師。陳宣帝於開皇二年冬新崩，陳後主在喪中即位，朝廷忙於喪禮與宮中變動，淮南防務一時鬆懈；隋文帝就在這個空檔出兵，出兵的名分寫的是陳國內有逆賊、隋軍奉辭討伐，實則是趁喪伐喪。同一時期北方與突厥的戰事又牽制了隋朝，使這次出兵只得以一場試探性的攻勢收場，而沒有打成全面戰爭。
causeEn: The root of the war lay in a south-north stand-off that had not changed for more than twenty years. Since its foundation in 557 the Chen had relied on the natural barrier of the Yangtze, holding the balance against the northern dynasties with the fortresses of the Hefei and Liyang line and with the river forces of the Huai; after the Sui took the throne by abdication in 581, Yang Jian wanted a unified empire in which troops could be ordered and taxes collected directly, and the southern dynasty was for him both an obstacle and a resource to be absorbed. Before Kaihuang 2 the Sui court had done three concrete things: it forbade the people south of the Yangtze to keep weapons privately and restricted their carts and oxen, on the pretext of forestalling disorder; it sent envoys south to the prefectures of the Huai and the Yangtze to sound out the country and win hearts, the most famous of these being the southern scholar He Ruobi's memorial on the state of the south; and it put the army in order year after year, working on the Shan Yang channel from Kaihuang 4 so that the grain of the Huai could run straight downstream, and building great numbers of war vessels on the middle and lower Yangtze in the seventh and eighth years of Kaihuang in preparation for a fleet. Emperor Xuan of Chen died in the winter of Kaihuang 2, the Houzhu succeeded him amid the mourning, the court was occupied with funeral matters and changes inside the palace, and the defence of the Huai relaxed for a moment; it was precisely into this gap that the Sui sent its army, the declared ground of the expedition being a rebellion inside the Chen to which the Sui army was answering the call of the loyal, which in truth was an attack taken advantage of the bereavement. The war against the Turks in the north was also pinning the Sui down at the same time, so that this campaign could only end as a probing offensive and not as a general war.
impact: 這一役本身沒有改變南北格局，但它把隋朝對南的戰爭從紙面推到了江淮。開皇二年之後，陳廷上下明白長江以北的防線並非牢固，淮南的州郡需要重整城塞、補給兵員，陳後主卻沒有改變荒唐的作派，前線連敗反而加深了將帥之間的互疑：宿將蕭摩訶在徐州握重兵而不得志，開皇十年前後終於與朝廷撕破臉，陳廷內部由此崩解，隋朝不必再一個城一個城硬攻。對隋朝而言，這一役確立了先取渡口、再以舟師壓江的取陳次序，開皇八年全面出兵時，隋軍的部署正是從開皇二年試出來的：主力沿江而下，水陸同時壓上，賀若弼自廣陵、韓擒虎自廬州兩路渡江，開皇九年正月入建康，陳朝亡國。自西晉末年分裂以來近三百年的南北分立就此終結，隋朝統一全國，開啟了隋唐帝國的版圖與盛期，也把南方的資源、江南士族和北方的兵馬合在同一個王朝的框架裏。同時，這一役之後的十餘年隋朝連年大舉用兵，役繁民疲，為大業末年的亂局埋下隱患，統一的代價要到隋末才完全兌現。
impactEn: This action by itself did not change the shape of the north and south, but it carried the Sui war against the south from the drafting table onto the ground between the Yangtze and the Huai. After Kaihuang 2 the Chen court understood that the line north of the Yangtze was not sound, and the prefectures of the Huai needed their walls repaired and their troops supplied; the Houzhu changed nothing, and defeats in the field only deepened the mistrust between the commanders, for the veteran Xiao Moha, holding great force in Xuzhou, was out of favour, and in the years around Kaihuang 10 he finally broke with the court. The Chen order collapsed from within, and the Sui no longer had to take city after city by assault. For the Sui the action settled the order of operations against the Chen: first seize the crossings, then bring the fleet down the river to press on the Yangtze. The deployment of the full campaign in Kaihuang 8 was exactly what had been rehearsed in Kaihuang 2, the main body coming down the river with the army and the fleet advancing together, He Ruobi crossing from Guangling and Han Qinhu from Luzhou, and in the first month of Kaihuang 9 the Sui entered Jiankang and the Chen perished. Close to three hundred years of division dating from the fall of Western Jin came to an end, the Sui unified the country and opened the map and the prosperous age of the Sui-Tang empire, folding the resources of the south, the southern gentry and the troops of the north into the frame of a single dynasty. At the same time, the decade of great campaigns that followed this action wore out the people and strained the resources of the state, planting the seeds of the disorder of the late Daye era; the price of unification was not paid off in full until the end of the Sui.
result: 這一役的結果是隋軍在正面交鋒中取勝：陳廷派往溳口前沿的部隊在甑山被擊散，《資治通鑑》記陳軍死者萬餘人，隋軍佔據了溳口渡口與淮北一線的陣地，陳軍退回濠、泗、楚一線的城池固守。隋軍卻沒有把勝利變成戰果的擴張：冬季糧運不繼，北面又有突厥之戰牽制，隋廷選擇收兵，把一次大舉出動只用在一場局部交鋒上，翌年春先後退回江淮以北。對隋朝來說，這是一場代價小、收穫大而用途明確的試探：它證明陳軍的淮南防線有破口，也證明冬季的江淮不適合大軍深入，於是隋朝調整戰略，先造舟師、先整運河，把全面進攻的時點推到開皇八年（588）。對陳朝來說，這是一次敗而未亡的教訓——防線被突破的警報已經響了，朝廷卻沒有因此改弦更張；宿將與朝廷的裂痕、無法補足的兵員與糧秣、被隋廷用高官厚爵拉攏的江南士人，都在此後五年裡一一顯形，最終在建康城破的那一天全部兌現。陳亡之後，隋朝把淮南與長江中下游的州郡重新編入郡縣，陳氏的舊臣或降或北走，江南的士族第一次以新王朝的地方官身份進入北方的官僚體系，而這場開皇二年冬天的甑山之戰，就是這條道路上最早的一級台階。
resultEn: The outcome of the action was a Sui victory in open battle: the detachment Chen had sent to the Bingkou front was scattered at Zengshan, the Zizhi tongjian records more than ten thousand of the Chen killed, the Sui occupied the crossing at Bingkou and the ground on the north bank of the Huai, and the Chen fell back to hold the cities of the Haozhou, Sizhou and Chuzhou line. The Sui did not turn that victory into an extension of the war: with the winter grain route failing and the war against the Turks still pinning the north, the court chose to withdraw, so that a great muster of troops was spent on a single local action, and the army pulled back north of the Yangtze and the Huai in the spring of the following year. For the Sui this was a probe that cost little, gained much and had an obvious use: it proved that the Chen line in the Huai had a gap in it, and equally that the middle Yangtze and Huai in winter would not support a deep advance by a mass of troops. The dynasty accordingly changed its method, building a fleet first and putting the Shan Yang channel in order first, and pushed the date of the general attack back to Kaihuang 8 (588). For the Chen it was a lesson survived but not a lesson learned: the alarm that the line had been breached had already sounded, yet the court set nothing in motion because of it. The rift between the veterans and the court, the men and grain that could not be made up, and the southern scholars drawn over by Sui offers of rank and emolument all came to light one by one in the five years that followed, and were all cashed in on the day Jiankang fell. After the fall of the Chen the Sui reorganised the prefectures of the Huai and the middle and lower Yangtze into commanderies and counties, the old ministers of the Chen either surrendered or went north, and the southern gentry entered the bureaucracy of the northern state for the first time as local officials of the new dynasty. The battle at Zengshan in the winter of Kaihuang 2 was the first step on that road.
